summary: UGI Corporation's indirect wholly owned subsidiary Mountaineer Gas Company entered a Note Purchase Agreement on September 28, 2026 for a private placement of $30 million 5.95% Senior Notes, Series H, maturing September 28, 2038, and $20 million 6.05% Senior Notes, Series I, maturing September 28, 2041. Funding occurred September 28, 2026, with semiannual interest on March 28 and September 28. Notes are unsecured and unsubordinated, pari passu with existing debt, priced June 30, 2026. Proceeds refinance debt and fund general corporate purposes. Covenants include a 0.65x total debt-to-capitalization cap and 15% asset-sale limit. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
